(“SHF”) – the main operation plant situated in China 75% owned Subsidiary: (i) HB Infrastructures and Technologies Sdn Bhd (“HBIT”) – the main operating situated in Malaysia Our group’s core activities involve the processing, packaging, and production of a diverse range of ready-toserve foods, frozen vegetables, and other food products through our subsidiaries.

Our company produces various food materials and quick-frozen products, mainly to meet the needs of our customers and distributors as well as is also an original equipment manufacturer (“OEM”) for third customer’s brand.
